parrafo.es: Robert y su equipo atienden corte de césped, poda de árboles, remoción de palmas y mantenimiento completo del jardín en Homestead. Precios razonables y trabajo puntual, según sus clientes.
parrafo.en: Robert and his crew handle mowing, tree trimming, palm removal and full landscape maintenance around Homestead. Reasonable prices and on-time work, according to his clients.

parrafo_1.es: Ferrara Lawn And Landscape es el negocio de Robert en Homestead. Corta césped, poda árboles, retira palmas y mantiene jardines completos en el sur de Miami-Dade.
parrafo_1.en: Ferrara Lawn And Landscape is Robert's business out of Homestead. He mows lawns, trims trees, removes palms and maintains full landscapes across southern Miami-Dade.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas destacan lo mismo: profesional, puntual y con precios razonables. Katelyn dice que dio una cotización el mismo día para podar un árbol de mango.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: professional, on time and reasonably priced. Katelyn says he gave her a same-day quote to cut back a mango tree.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesita tu jardín: corte, poda, remoción o diseño.
texto.en: Tell us what your yard needs: mowing, trimming, removal or design.

texto.es: Robert suele dar el precio el mismo día que lo llamas.
texto.en: Robert often gives you a price the same day you call.

texto.es: Su equipo ejecuta el trabajo con cuidado y respeta tus indicaciones.
texto.en: His crew carries out the job carefully and follows your instructions.

texto.es: Muchos clientes se quedan para el mantenimiento regular del césped.
texto.en: Many clients stay on for regular lawn maintenance after the first visit.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el terreno. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the property. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Mantenimiento regular con rayas limpias y bordes definidos.
texto.en: Regular mowing with clean stripes and sharp edges.

texto.es: Poda de árboles y palmas, incluida la remoción de palmas de coco.
texto.en: Tree and palm trimming, including coconut palm removal.

texto.es: Diseño de jardineras, setos y plantación de árboles nuevos.
texto.en: Garden bed design, hedge work and new tree planting.

texto.es: Luces instaladas en jardineras para resaltar la entrada de tu casa.
texto.en: Lighting installed in garden beds to highlight your home's entrance.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Phenomenal work. I had the best experience with their service. They worked with me on the price but did a job worth more than I could've ever paid. I'm back to believing in humanity.
Excellent job, they arrived on time, Robert and his team were very careful when doing the work and followed my instructions carefully. Very professional and has reasonable prices, highly recommended.
Very nice and professional. Came and gave a reasonable quote same day to cut back our mango tree. Was on time when we scheduled and did a great job. Great communication. Highly recommended!
